svg.aria-label: Mission 4 setup: a wire donut of 10 turns, about 1 metre of twisted wire, and a compass detector with the rest of the wire wrapped 15 times round it along the needle. The two bare ends are twisted together. No battery. Push a magnet through the donut and watch the needle.
svg.title: Mission 4 setup: a wire donut of 10 turns, about 1 metre of twisted wire, and a compass detector with the rest of the wire wrapped 15 times round it along the needle. The two bare ends are twisted together. No battery. Push a magnet through the donut and watch the needle.
svg.text: wrapped round a can, then taped
keeps the magnet far from the compass
